mapper.select:
select t3.* from (select t2.*,cap.project_name,cap.project_number,cap.project_date,(select su.description from sys_user su where su.user_id = cap.user_id) as create_person from ( select t1.project_id, sum(t1.uncollected_principal) as uncollected_principal, sum(t1.uncollected_interest) as uncollected_interest from (SELECT capc.property_contract_id, capc.over_due, capc.project_id, capc.product_id, capc.total_principal, capc.total_interest, capc.uncollected_principal, capc.uncollected_interest, fc.contract_number, fc.contract_name, ( SELECT hbm.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm, fct_project_bp fpb WHERE hbm.bp_id = fpb.bp_id AND fpb.project_id = fc.project_id AND fpb.credit_grantor_party = 'Y' ) AS bp_name FROM ct_abs_property_contract capc, fct_contract fc where capc.contract_id = fc.contract_id and capc.document_type = 'FCT_CONTRACT'
UNION
SELECT capc.property_contract_id, capc.over_due, capc.project_id, capc.product_id, capc.total_principal, capc.total_interest, capc.uncollected_principal, capc.uncollected_interest, cc.contract_number, cc.contract_name, ( SELECT hbm.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm WHERE cc.tenant_id = hbm.bp_id ) AS bp_name FROM ct_abs_property_contract capc , con_contract cc where capc.contract_id = cc.contract_id and capc.document_type = 'CON_CONTRACT') t1 group by t1.project_id) t2 ,ct_abs_project cap where t2.project_id = cap.project_id) t3 1=1
and (t3.project_name like concat('%',concat(#{projectName},'%')) or t3.project_number like concat('%',concat(#{projectNumber},'%')))

SELECT t1.* FROM ( SELECT cc.contract_id, cc.contract_name, cc.contract_number, cc.company_id, 'CON_CONTRACT' AS document_type FROM ( SELECT c.contract_id, c.contract_name,c.contract_number,c.company_id, c.data_class, c.contract_status FROM con_contract c ) cc WHERE cc.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND cc.contract_status = 'INCEPT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc WHERE ccc.contract_id = cc.contract_id AND ccc.write_off_flag != 'FULL' )
UNION
SELECT fc.contract_id, fc.contract_name, fc.contract_number, fc.company_id, 'FCT_CONTRACT' AS document_type FROM fct_contract fc WHERE fc.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND fc.contract_status = 'INCEPT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fct_quotation_cashflow fqc WHERE fqc.contract_id = fc.contract_id AND fqc.write_off_flag != 'FULL' ) ) t1
t1.company_id = #{request.companyId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ct_abs_property_contract capc WHERE capc.contract_id = t1.contract_id AND capc.document_type = t1.document_type )
and t1.contract_name like concat('%',concat(#{contractName},'%'))
and t1.contract_number like concat('%',concat(#{contractNumber},'%'))
ORDER BY t1.contract_id DESC
